title: Load Tender Log Form
subtitle: Load Tender: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Load Tender Log Form covers offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance. The transport planning coordinator records Load Tender events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Load Tender Log Form keeps Load Tender exceptions visible until the transport planning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Load Tender Log Form at origin, destination, route, pickup window, delivery window, and equipment location. Document offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance identity before Load Tender begins. Compare offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance findings with stated Load Tender criteria; route unresolved Load Tender issues to authorized carrier-management reviewer. For Load Tender Log Form, confirm requirements for Load Tender. Ask authorized carrier-management reviewer to review Load Tender conditions beyond the transport planning coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Load Tender, identify responsible parties, origin, destination, route, pickup window, delivery window, and equipment location, and the linked offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance source.

fields.label: Equipment, commodity, quantity, weight, and handling references

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Load Tender facts for offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Load Tender tracked controls
items: Acceptance, rejection, counteroffer, and dispatch handoff

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Load Tender event before closeout. Transport Planning Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Rate or instruction changed without authority
blocks.guidance: Pause Load Tender when carrier, capacity, equipment, commitment, rate, or instruction authorization remains unresolved. Retain the available Load Tender proof and route unresolved offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance scope to transport planning coordinator.
